The season started on 22 August 2022 and concluded on 29 May 2023.{{cite web |title=رسميًا.. تحديد موعد انطلاق "دوري يلو" لموسم "2022-2023" |url=https://akhbaar24.argaam.com/article/detail/597352}} On 5 May, [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]] became the first team to be promoted following [[Al-Faisaly FC|Al-Faisaly]]'s 2–2 draw with [[Najran SC|Najran]].{{cite web |title=بعد 312 يوما.. الأهلي يعود |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/804804}} They were crowned champions following a 1–0 win against [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] on 23 May.{{cite web |title=بعد صعوده لدوري روشن.. الأهلي بطلاً لدوري يلو لأندية الدرجة الأولى |url=https://sabq.org/sports/new8sgf1yp}} The second club to be promoted was [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]] who were promoted after Al-Faisaly's 2–2 draw with [[Jeddah Club|Jeddah]] on 15 May.{{cite web |title=نادي الأخدود يصعد لأول مرة في تاريخه لدوري روشن للمحترفين |url=https://www.al-jazirah.com/2023/20230516/sp11.htm}} The third club to be promoted was [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]] who were promoted following a 1–0 home win against [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]].{{cite web |title=بعد 18 عاما.. «مدرسة الوسطى» بين الكبار |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/805945}} The fourth and final club to be promoted was [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] who were promoted following a 3–2 win against [[Al-Sahel SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Sahel]].{{cite web |title=الحزم يخطف بطاقة الصعود الأخيرة |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/805997}} On 1 May, [[Al-Shoulla F.C.|Al-Shoulla]] became the first team to be relegated following [[Jeddah Club|Jeddah]]'s 1–0 win against [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]].{{cite web |title=العين يفوز والشعلة يهبط |url=https://albiladdaily.com/2023/05/03/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%8A%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B2-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B9%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D9%87%D8%A8%D8%B7/}} On 23 May, [[Al-Sahel SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Sahel]] became the second team to be relegated despite a 3–2 win against Al-Okhdood.{{cite web |title=رغم فوزه على الأخدود … الساحل يودع منافسات “يلو” |url=https://al-kas.com/100602/}} [[Najran SC|Najran]] became the third and final club to be relegated after a 4–1 defeat to derby rivals Al-Okhdood on the final matchday.{{cite web |title=نجران يرافق الساحل والشعلة في الهبوط من دوري يلو |url=https://www.alyaum.com/article/6470004}} ==Overview== ===Changes=== On 9 October 2020, the Saudi FF announced that the number of teams in the league would be decreased to 18 starting from the 2022–23 season. Due to this decision, 5 teams were relegated last season instead of the usual 4 teams. In addition, only 3 teams were promoted from the [[2021–22 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] instead of 4 teams.{{cite web |title=تقليص أندية دوري الأولى إلى 18 نادٍ ..و استحداث دوري الثالثة..و استبدال دوري المناطق بالدرجة الرابعة |date=9 October 2020|url=https://lym.news/a/6281594}} On 14 April 2022, the Saudi FF announced that the number of teams in the [[Saudi Professional League|Pro League]] would be increased from 16 to 18 teams. To prepare for this change, only 2 teams would be relegated to the First Division League and 4 teams would be promoted to the Pro League.{{cite web |title=رسمياً.. زيادة عدد أندية الدوري السعودي والأجانب |url=https://www.alarabiya.net/sport/saudi-sport/2022/04/14/%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%A3%D9%86%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A8}} ==Team changes== The following teams have changed division since the 2022–23 season. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} ===To the First Division League=== '''Promoted from [[2021–22 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Arabi (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Arabi]] * [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] * [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]] '''Relegated from [[2021–22 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] * [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]] * [[Al-Faisaly FC|Al-Faisaly]] {{col-break|gap=3em}} ===From the First Division League=== '''Promoted to [[2022–23 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]''' * [[Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] * [[Al-Adalah FC|Al-Adalah]] * [[Al Wehda FC|Al-Wehda]] '''Relegated to [[20SSS22–23 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]]''' * [[Al-Jeel Club|Al-Jeel]] * [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] * [[Al-Nahda Club (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Nahda]] * [[Al-Kawkab FC|Al-Kawkab]] * [[Bisha FC|Bisha]] {{col-end}} ==Teams== A total of 18 teams are contesting the league, including 12 sides from the [[2021–22 Saudi First Division League|2021–22 season]], the three promoted teams from the [[2021–22 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and the three relegated sides from the [[2021–22 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]. The first club to be relegated to the First Division League was [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] following a 5–2 defeat away to [[Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] on 21 May.{{cite web |title=الاتفاق يتنفس الصعداء ويؤكد هبوط الحزم |date=21 May 2022 |url=https://lym.news/a/6397942}} Al-Hazem were relegated after just one year in the top flight. This was their second relegation in three years. Both [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]] and [[Al-Faisaly FC|Al-Faisaly]] were relegated following on the final day of the season. Al-Ahli were relegated following a 0–0 away draw with [[Al-Shabab FC (Riyadh)|Al-Shabab]].{{cite web |title=الأهلي.. صدمة الهبوط |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/772859}} Al-Ahli were relegated for the first time in their history while Al-Faisaly were relegated after 12 consecutive seasons in the top flight. The first club to be promoted was [[Al-Arabi (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Arabi]] who were promoted following a 1–0 home win against [[Al-Rawdhah Club|Al-Rawdhah]] on 30 March 2022.{{cite web |title=بعد 28 عاما العربي يعود إلى الأولى |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/763597}} On 31 March 2022, [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] became the second side to be promoted following a 2–1 win over [[Al-Nairyah Club|Al-Nairyah]].{{cite web |title=القيصومة ثاني الصاعدين لدوري «يلو» |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/763659}} The third and final club to be promoted was [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]], who were promoted following a 3–2 aggregate win over [[Al-Taraji Club|Al-Taraji]] in the promotion play-offs.{{cite web |title=بعد 6 أعوام.. الرياض يعود إلى «الأولى» |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/765759}} Al-Arabi were crowned champions after defeating Al-Qaisumah 1–0 to win their second title and first since 1986.{{cite web |title=رسمياً .. العربي بطلاً لدوري الدرجة الثانية |url=https://www.dawriplus.com/news/61058-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9.html}} Al-Arabi returned to the [[Saudi First Division League|First Division League]] after an absence of 27 years. They returned to the league for the first time since the 1994–95 season and would play in their 9th overall season. Al-Qaisumah returned after an absence of three seasons and would play in their 4th overall season in the First Division League. Al-Riyadh returned after an absence of six seasons and would play in their 18th overall season in the First Division League. ===Stadia and locations===
